Each transmission request of an OFS message shall be monitored for a transmit confirmation timeout. If CanTSyn_TxConfirmation is not called within 3 sec after transmission request, CanTSyn shall • wait until CanTSyn_TxConfirmation is called (with E_OK or E_NOT_OK ) and • send no OFNS message and • instead reset the state machine to start with a new OFS transmission once it is due.
